name: Chepekwe
body:
CHEPEKWE
CR 6

A squat, barrel-chested quadruped with a thick, smooth hide. Flap-like ears frame its head, and a single pale horn juts from its broad snout.

XP 2,400
N Large animal
Init +4; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 9, flat-footed 19 (+10 natural, –1 size)
hp 76 (9d8+36)
Fort +10, Ref +6, Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee gore +12 (2d6+10)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks amphibious assault, capsize, powerful charge (gore, 4d6+14), trample (1d8+10, DC 21)

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 10, Con 19, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 7
Base Atk +6; CMB +14; CMD 24 (28 vs. trip)
Feats Endurance, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Perception +15, Swim +19
SQ hold breath

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Amphibious Assault (Ex)

A chepekwe can still use its powerful charge while underwater, this deals 4d6+10 damage. A chepekwe can also use trample while submerged, but the DC has a –4 penalty and, as this deals bludgeoning damage, it only deals half damage underwater.

Capsize (Ex)

A chepekwe can overturn a boat of its size or smaller by ramming it as a charge attack and making a CMB check. The DC of this check is 25 or the result of the boat captain’s Profession (sailor) check, whichever is higher.

Hold Breath (Ex)

A chepekwe can hold its breath for a number of minutes equal to its Constitution score before it risks drowning.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm and temperate swamps
Organization solitary, pair, or herd (3–12)
Treasure none

This irascible herbivore has a body resembling that of a small elephant, with small flap-like elephantine ears, but its head is otherwise that of a one-horned rhinoceros. Unlike either creature, the chepekwe lives in swampy terrain rather than the savannah and dines primarily on marsh reeds and rotting vegetation, as well as sweeping up small waterborne insects, snails, and similar creatures that infest them. Like the rhinoceros, the chepekwe is ill-tempered and aggressive, prone to charge other large creatures that come into view and do not immediately flee when it bellows a challenge.
